Area.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/4] Lack of time spent with patients was often tied to comments about overreliance on medications. Many men said that they were prescribed medications but no one spoke to them about their problems or indicated an interest in hearing about them as indicated in the following remarks: [/page/5/Text/7] "When I started feeling anxious or stuff, they'd give me a pill, instead of trying to find out why I'm feeling anxious. If they're mental health nurses they should be doing more than just giving out pills" (7:174)
